#!/bin/bash

if [ $# -ne 2 ] && [ $# -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Uso: ./descargar_todos.sh <directorio> [carpeta_destino]"

fi

directorio=$1
carpeta_destino=${2:-"Descargas"}

if [ ! -d "$directorio" ]; then
  echo "O directorio $directorio non existe"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -d "$carpeta_destino" ]; then
  echo "A carpeta $carpeta_destino xa existe"

fi

for f in "$directorio"/*; do

  echo "Descargando $filename..."
  wget "$f" -O "$carpeta_destino/$filename"
done

echo "Descargas completas"

exit 0
